releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.15 — faster and more complete. Scrolling is smoother: bubbles no longer create a render layer each, list rows keep their composition slots, and the conversation, history, discover and status lists stop re-filtering on every frame. Chats now open at the point you left off with an 'Unread messages' marker instead of jumping to the newest, a floating button jumps back to the latest message, and new messages never yank the viewport while you are reading history. New: edit your own messages (with the 'edited' tag), tap a photo or video to open it full screen, an empty-chat prompt, and confirmation toasts for copy, edit, delete and forward.
